Private Arizona Day Tours

Scottsdale Sprinters runs private chauffeured day tours from Scottsdale and Phoenix, priced by vehicle for the whole day before tax: the Sedona Red Rocks day (12 hours) is $1,250 in the 6-seat Luxury SUV (Suburban) or $1,450 in the 14-seat Executive Black Sprinter, and the Grand Canyon South Rim day (14 hours) is $1,500 in the 6-seat Luxury SUV (Suburban) or $1,740 in the 14-seat Executive Black Sprinter. Every other tour below is priced the same way, from the vehicle's published hourly rate and billable hours, and your route, stops and access are confirmed in writing before you travel.

Sedona and Grand Canyon day tours by vehicle and group size

Each day price is the vehicle's published hourly rate times the day's billable hours, before tax; the vehicle and the chauffeur stay with the group for the whole day. Sedona Red Rocks: 10-12 hours, priced as a 12-hour day that bills 10 hours in every vehicle. Grand Canyon South Rim: 12-14 hours, priced as a 14-hour day that bills 12 hours in every vehicle.
